description: Read C2PA Content Credentials from an image, video, audio or PDF file (by public URL or base64, up to 20 MiB). Reports the manifest, recorded actions and digital source type, with cryptographic validation and signer trust as separate findings. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

file_base64.description: File bytes as base64 or a data: URL, up to 20 MiB decoded. Prefer url when the file is public.

media_type.description: MIME type of the base64 file, for example image/jpeg.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private network and local addresses are refused.

name: read_content_credentials
title: Read C2PA Content Credentials
